title: Fishing (DS)
wikitext:
'''Fishing''' is one of the activities that you can do in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]''. ==Obtaining the Fishing Rod== The Fishing Rod can be obtained by visiting [[Galen (DS)|Galen's]] house between 11am and 6pm on Saturday in any season. Make sure you do not have a tool equipped. ==General== The three sizes fish come in are Small, Medium and Large. Certain fish can only be caught in certain seasons.
